  name: ml-pipeline-ui-signing-key-init-d6km5hkhmm
  namespace: gpu-kubeflow-lab
spec:
  activeDeadlineSeconds: 300
  backoffLimit: 0
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        application-crd-id: kubeflow-pipelines
        sidecar.istio.io/inject: 'false'
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: dra-book
        app.kubernetes.io/component: kfp-backend

      containers:
      - command:
        - node

        env:
        - name: POD_NAMESPACE
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: metadata.namespace
        - name: SIGNING_SECRET_NAME
          valueFrom:
            configMapKeyRef:
              key: secretName
              name: ml-pipeline-ui-signing-key-init-d6km5hkhmm
        - name: SIGNING_SECRET_KEY
          valueFrom:
            configMapKeyRef:
              key: secretKey
              name: ml-pipeline-ui-signing-key-init-d6km5hkhmm
        image: ghcr.io/kubeflow/kfp-frontend:2.17.1@sha256:130dbbbaaa0ac7c1e200f38eda7ac66d708891014eb8cb8b9b78dfe14260c107
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        name: initialize
        resources:
          limits:
            memory: 128Mi
          requests:
            cpu: 10m
            memory: 64Mi
        securityContext:

data.artifactRepository:
archiveLogs: true
s3:
  endpoint: "seaweedfs.gpu-kubeflow-lab.svc:9000"
  bucket: "mlpipeline"
  # keyFormat is a format pattern to define how artifacts will be organized in a bucket.
  # It can reference workflow metadata variables such as workflow.namespace, workflow.name,
  # pod.name. Can also use strftime formating of workflow.creationTimestamp so that workflow
  # artifacts can be organized by date. If omitted, will use `{{workflow.name}}/{{pod.name}}`,
  # which has potential for have collisions, because names do not guarantee they are unique
  # over the lifetime of the cluster.
  # Refer to https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/.
  #
  # The following format looks like:
  # artifacts/my-workflow-abc123/2018/08/23/my-workflow-abc123-1234567890
  # Adding date into the path greatly reduces the chance of {{pod.name}} collision.
  keyFormat: "private-artifacts/{{workflow.namespace}}/{{workflow.name}}/{{workflow.creationTimestamp.Y}}/{{workflow.creationTimestamp.m}}/{{workflow.creationTimestamp.d}}/{{pod.name}}"
  insecure: true
  accessKeySecret:
    name: mlpipeline-minio-artifact
    key: accesskey
  secretKeySecret:
    name: mlpipeline-minio-artifact
    key: secretkey

command:
# Wait up to 120 seconds  for SeaweedFS master to be ready
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  if wget -q --spider http://127.0.0.1:8333/status; then
    break
  fi
  if [ "$i" -eq 60 ]; then
    echo "ERROR: SeaweedFS master did not become ready within 120 seconds"
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 2
done

# Create bucket with retries (maximum 25 seconds)
for attempt in $(seq 1 5); do
  if bucket_listing=$(echo "s3.bucket.list" | /usr/bin/weed shell 2>/dev/null); then
    if printf '%s\n' "$bucket_listing" | grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*mlpipeline[[:space:]]'; then
      break
    fi
    if echo "s3.bucket.create --name mlpipeline" | /usr/bin/weed shell >/dev/null 2>&1 &&
      bucket_listing=$(echo "s3.bucket.list" | /usr/bin/weed shell 2>/dev/null) &&
      printf '%s\n' "$bucket_listing" | grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*mlpipeline[[:space:]]'; then
      break
    fi
  fi
  if [ "$attempt" -eq 5 ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Could not verify or create mlpipeline bucket after 5 attempts"
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 5
done

# Configure admin user with retries (25s max)
for i in $(seq 1 5); do
  if echo "s3.configure -user kubeflow-admin -access_key $accesskey -secret_key $secretkey -actions Admin -apply" | /usr/bin/weed shell 2>&1; then
    break
  fi
  if [ "$i" -eq 5 ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Failed to configure kubeflow-admin after 5 attempts"
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 5
done

# Verify bucket is accessible
if ! echo "s3.bucket.list" | /usr/bin/weed shell | grep -q mlpipeline; then
  echo "ERROR: mlpipeline bucket verification failed"
  exit 1
fi

# Signal successful initialization for the startup probe
touch /tmp/initialization-complete
